text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「板金の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 曲げの内側の半径は板厚以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (inside bend radius not smaller than the sheet thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

rules.text: 穴の中心から板の縁までの距離は板厚の 2 倍以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (hole centre to edge at least twice the thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「締結の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: ボルト穴の中心から縁までの距離は穴径の 1.2 倍以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 3.5(1) and Table 3.3 (printed p. 23): minimum end distance e1 = 1.2 d0 and minimum edge distance e2 = 1.2 d0; 1.5 Symbols (p. 13): d0 = hole diameter, e1/e2 measured from the centre of the fastener hole to the adjacent end/edge (e1 in the direction of load transfer, e2 at right angles to it). Maximum e1, e2 = 4t + 40 mm for steel exposed to weather, larger of 8t or 125 mm for unprotected EN 10025-5 steel, otherwise unlimited (note 1). Fatigue: see EN 1993-1-9 (3.5(2)). Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 25 and p. 15), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: 鋼どうしのねじのかみ合い長さは呼び径以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb for steel screwed into steel; no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「溶接の決まり」から 3 件の規則

rules.text: 溶接する角形鋼管の外形 (b, h) は肉厚の 35 倍以下
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 7.5.1 and Table 7.8 "Range of validity for welded joints between CHS or RHS brace members and RHS chord members" (printed p. 116): RHS braces bi/ti <= 35 and hi/ti <= 35 (tension; in compression also Class 1 or 2 for T, Y, X and K/N gap joints, Class 1 for overlap joints); RHS chord b0/t0 <= 35 and h0/t0 <= 35 and Class 1 or 2 for T, Y, X and K/N gap joints (overlap joints: Class 1 or 2 only). Outside the range all failure modes of 7.2.2 and secondary moments are to be considered (7.5.1(3)). The limit 35 holds for rectangular sections only; circular tubes are WD-03 (Table 7.1). The check does not look at the section class. Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 118), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: すみ肉溶接の長さは、のど厚の 6 倍と 30 mm の大きい方以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 4.5.1(2) (printed p. 42): a fillet weld whose effective length is less than 30 mm or less than 6 times its throat thickness, whichever is larger, is not to be designed to carry load. The length meant is the effective length l_eff (4.5.1(1): the length over which the fillet is full size; may be taken as the overall length minus 2a, no reduction if full size including starts and ends); a = effective throat thickness (4.5.2), itself at least 3 mm (4.5.2(2)). Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 44), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: 溶接する円形鋼管の外径は肉厚の 50 倍以下
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 7.4.1 and Table 7.1 "Range of validity for welded joints between CHS members" (printed p. 108): chord 10 <= d0/t0 <= 50 ("generally"; the scan prints "but:" and nothing after it), brace in tension di/ti <= 50, members in compression Class 1 or 2; Table 7.8 (printed p. 116) also gives di/ti <= 50 for a circular brace in tension on a rectangular chord. Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 110 and 118), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf. The check is the upper limit 50 only: the lower limit 10 for chords, the section class and the exception behind "but:" are not checked. The limit was 35 for every tube before 2026-11-03; 35 is the rectangular one (WD-01)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「公差の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 組み合う部品の隙間は、公差の積み上げより大きい
rules.basis: ordinary tolerance-stack practice (assumption); no single primary source was read

rules.text: 固定のボルトの位置の公差は、(隙間穴の径 - ボルトの径) / 2 以内
rules.basis: Fixed-fastener formula T = (H - F)/2 as given in Goodheart-Willcox, "GD&T: Application and Interpretation", 7th ed., p. 308 (secondary source; the ASME Y14.5 text itself was not opened). There T = position tolerance applied to all holes (the value in the feature control frame, at MMC), H = MMC size of the clearance holes (smallest hole), F = MMC size of the fastener (largest fastener). So clearance_hole_mm is the smallest clearance-hole diameter and bolt_diameter_mm the largest bolt diameter. Condition: holds only if the fixed (threaded / press-fit) feature carries a projected tolerance zone or the clearance-hole part is very thin. Floating fasteners (clearance holes in all parts) use T = H - F instead (same book, same page). Read 2026-11-03 in a saved copy of https://www.g-wonlinetextbooks.com/gdt-application-and-interpretation-2021/324 (printed page 308)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「人の決まり」から 3 件の規則

rules.text: 座面の幅は、座位殿幅 (若年女性 95 %) 391 mm 以上
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, item J2 座位殿幅:足底支持 (hip breadth, sitting, feet supported), statistics table https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/gif/J2.gif (from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html): young adults, female, 95th percentile 391.0 mm (N 202). Young adults = 18-29 years, women measured July-August 1992 (https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/index.html, section 1.2-1.3). The elderly female 95th percentile is 391.4 mm, so the limit also covers that group to within 1 mm. Read 2026-11-03

rules.text: 座面の奥行きは、座位殿・膝窩距離 (若年女性 5 %) 406 mm 以下
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, item J6 座位殿・膝窩距離 (buttock-popliteal length, sitting), statistics table https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/gif/J6.gif (from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html): young adults, female, 5th percentile 406.0 mm (N 202). Young adults = 18-29 years, women measured July-August 1992 (https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/index.html, section 1.2-1.3). The limit holds for that group only: the elderly (60+) female 5th percentile in the same table is 391.2 mm. Read 2026-11-03. The seat box may include the back, so a hit is a question to the designer, not a verdict

rules.text: 動いて閉じる隙間は、指が入る 25 mm より小さくしない
rules.basis: ISO 13854:1996, 4.2 Table 1 (minimum gap a: finger 25 mm; hand/wrist/fist 100, arm 120, toes 50, foot 120, leg 180, head 300, body 500), iTeh sample p.3 (PDF p.7), https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf , read 2026-11-03. Condition (4.1 b): if a larger body part can foreseeably enter the crushing zone, the gap for the largest part applies, so 25 mm is a floor only for zones that admit nothing larger than a finger; children and bulky clothing must also be considered. The current edition is ISO 13854:2017 (2nd ed., a "minor revision" per its foreword, ANSI preview read 2026-11-03); its Table 1 was not reachable (the preview stops before clause 4), so the 2017 finger value is not checked

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「電池の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 使う気温の高い側は、LiFePO4 セルの上限 55 degC 以下
rules.basis: EVE Energy LF50K Product Specification, file LF50K-73103 version D (2019-12-02), sec. 3 Nominal Technical Parameter, row 7 charge temperature 0-55 degC and row 8 discharge temperature -20-55 degC (row 9 storage: 1 month -20-45 degC, 1 year 0-35 degC), https://www.rcscomponents.kiev.ua/datasheets/LF50K32V50AhProduct%20Specification.pdf (a distributor's copy of the maker's specification); read 2026-11-03. 55 degC is the upper limit for both charging and discharging, i.e. for use; storage limits are lower and are not checked here. Q19 is the hot end of the range of use, so this is a first screen; the thermal tests (T1) judge the cell temperature itself

rules.text: 電池の電圧は 60 V (直流) 以下。超えると高電圧の扱いが要る
rules.basis: UN Regulation No. 100 (02 series of amendments), MLIT English/Japanese text, para. 2.17: "High Voltage" is a working voltage > 60 V and <= 1500 V DC (or > 30 V and <= 1000 V AC rms); para. 2.38: the working voltage is the highest voltage the maker specifies in open circuit or normal operation (so the full-charge voltage, not the nominal one), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R100.pdf; read 2026-11-03. This text says "High Voltage", not "voltage class B". R100 Part I itself covers M and N1 vehicles above 25 km/h; the rule uses its 60 V DC line as the threshold for high-voltage handling on any vehicle

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「組み立ての決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 1 人で持ち上げる部品は 23 kg 以下
rules.basis: Waters, Putz-Anderson, Garg, Fine, "Revised NIOSH equation for the design and evaluation of manual lifting tasks", Ergonomics 36(7):749-776, 1993, https://doi.org/10.1080/00140139308967940, sec. 6.2 (p.762) and Appendix A (LC = 23 kg / 51 lb), sec. 8.1 limitations (p.768-769); read 2026-11-03. The 23 kg is the load constant: the recommended weight limit at the standard lifting location (75 cm high, 25 cm out) under ideal conditions (all six multipliers = 1: sagittal, occasional, good coupling, short travel). The equation reduces it for real postures and frequencies; it is for two-handed lifting and not for one-handed, seated/kneeling or constrained-space lifts. This rule uses the 23 kg as the one-person limit for any lift, which is the most lenient value the equation allows. A hit means two people or a lifting aid are needed

rules.text: 部品の箱は地面より下に出ない
rules.basis: a check of the geometry (the origin is on the ground), not taken from a source (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「サスの決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: サスのストロークは、通る段差の高さ (Q15) 以上
rules.basis: engineering assumption, not taken from a source; Q15 is the step height in mm

rules.text: 荷を載せた静的なたわみは、サスのストローク以内
rules.basis: engineering assumption: the whole mass is shared equally by the supports and the spring is linear, so the static deflection is load / stiffness

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「製造の決まり」から 1 件の規則

rules.text: 角形鋼管の肉厚は、規格品の下限 1.6 mm 以上
rules.basis: JIS G 3466 table 5 (square) and table 6 (rectangular), read in the JISF committee draft of the revision dated 2024-12-20 (資料 16, PDF p.9-12), https://www.jisf.or.jp/business/standard/jis/documents/docs_kouzai_1600_JISG3466_20241220.pdf, and the maker's range table of 日鐵住金建材 角パイプ (STKR) 製造可能範囲 (catalogue p.4), https://www.ns-kenzai.co.jp/pdf/a1/u-kaku-eco_kikaku.pdf; read 2026-11-03. The thinnest wall in both tables is 1.6 mm (sides 40-75 mm square, and rectangles up to 125x40); larger tubes start thicker (80-100 square 2.3, 125 square 3.2, 150-300 square 4.5). Clause 8.1 lets other sizes be agreed between buyer and maker, so 1.6 mm is the lower limit of the listed sizes, not a ban. The issued standard (2015 edition with amendment, as used for data/sections/standard_tubes.json) was not reopened for this rule; the draft lists the same 112 sizes

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「系の決まり」から 9 件の規則

rules.text: 走る製品は、動力源から駆動輪まで、トルクを伝える鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum for a self-propelled product (the driven wheels, support.actuation.drive, are reached from the motor or engine by links that carry torque); not taken from a standard

rules.text: 人が乗って走る製品は、ハンドルから操舵輪まで、操舵の鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a steering input reaches every steered support). Steering equipment of road vehicles is regulated by UN Regulation No. 79, "Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to steering equipment" (in force 1 December 1988); its paragraph 1 (Scope) applies it to the steering equipment of vehicles of categories M, N and O, and paragraph 2.3 defines steering equipment as all the equipment that determines the direction of movement (steering control, steering transmission, steered wheels, energy supply if any). In that original text paragraph 1 also leaves out transmissions that are purely hydraulic or electric at any point (except auxiliary steering equipment). Read in the original text, United Nations Treaty Series vol. 1519, A-4789 (https://treaties.un.org/doc/Publication/UNTS/Volume%201519/volume-1519-A-4789-English.pdf), and the UN Treaty Collection status page XI-B-16-79, read 2026-11-03. The current text (04 series of amendments) was not opened; the rule does not take any value from the regulation

rules.text: 走る製品は、制動の入力から制動する輪まで、制動の鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a brake input reaches every braked support). Braking of road vehicles is regulated. UN Regulation No. 13-H, "Uniform provisions concerning the approval of passenger cars with regard to braking": paragraph 1.1 applies it to the braking of vehicles of categories M1 and N1, and paragraph 1.2 leaves out vehicles with a design speed not over 25 km/h and vehicles fitted for invalid drivers (read in MLIT's English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R013H.pdf). Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号) 第12条 (制動装置), paragraph 1: a motor vehicle must have two or more braking systems (二系統以上) meeting the braking performance set by 告示; one system is enough for vehicles with a maximum speed under 25 km/h, large special vehicles under 35 km/h and small special farm vehicles (read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). Both read 2026-11-03. The rule checks one connected brake chain, not the number of systems or their performance

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a seat is joined to the frame by some chain of links)

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席ごとに拘束 (シートベルトなど) が座席と骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (each seat has a restraint joined to the seat and to the frame). Road vehicles: 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号) 第22条の3 (座席ベルト等), paragraph 1, asks for seat belts and their anchorages (取付装置) on the seats listed in its table (a lap-and-shoulder 第二種座席ベルト on forward-facing seats of passenger vehicles under 10 seats, for example); two-wheelers, sidecar two-wheelers and vehicles under 20 km/h (other than large and small special vehicles) are left out, and so are some seat kinds (read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). Recreational off-highway vehicles: ANSI/ROHVA 1 (current edition 2023 per ROHVA, https://rohva.org/ansi-standard/, which lists an Occupant Retention System among its contents). The standard itself was not opened (sold); secondary: CPSC staff letter to ROHVA of 10 March 2011 on the canvass draft (section 11.1 Seat Belts asks for at least a three-point seat belt; https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/pdfs/blk_pdf_commcanvass03102111.pdf) and CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964 (19 Nov 2014), p. 68985-68986 (ANSI/ROHVA 1-2011 section 11.2 seat belt reminder, 11.3 ORS zones; ORS defined as including three-point seat belts; https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-11-19/html/2014-26500.htm). All read 2026-11-03

rules.text: 人が乗って屋外の悪路を走る製品は、乗員を囲む転倒保護の枠 (ROPS) が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a roll-over protective structure is in the design and joined to the frame; that it encloses the occupants is not checked here). ANSI/ROHVA 1 (current edition 2023) lists a Roll Over Protective Structure (ROPS) among the requirements it covers (ROHVA's page, https://rohva.org/ansi-standard/); the CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964 (19 Nov 2014) describes ROVs as equipped with ROPS (p. 68964) and puts ROPS in its proposed ROV definition, 16 CFR 1422.2(a) (p. 69022) (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-11-19/html/2014-26500.htm). Read 2026-11-03. The standard text was not opened (sold): its ROPS clause number and test method were not seen, and ROHVA 1 covers ROVs only (in the NPR definition, among other features, a top speed over 30 mph)

rules.text: 公道を走る製品は、前照灯・尾灯・制動灯・方向指示器がそろう
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (one of each in the design). Lamps of road vehicles are regulated by Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号): 第32条 (前照灯等; 走行用前照灯 para. 1, すれ違い用前照灯 para. 4, on the front), 第37条 (尾灯), 第39条 (制動灯), 第41条 (方向指示器). 第37条 and 第39条 para. 1 ask for the lamp on both sides of the rear (one is enough for two-wheelers and vehicles 0.8 m wide or less) and do not apply to 軽自動車 and 小型特殊自動車 under 20 km/h; 第41条 para. 1 leaves out vehicles under 20 km/h shorter than 6 m with the driver's seat outside a cabin (and other listed conditions). Colour, brightness and mounting are left to the 告示 (not opened). Read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067), 2026-11-03. The design check counts one of each, not two per rear side

rules.text: 電池を積む製品は、電池からモーターまで、電力を伝える鎖が切れずにつながる

text:
要件は在宅の電動介護ベッド (背上げ・膝上げ・高さ調整) なので、型は care_bed を選んだ。ほかに型は無い。体重 Q33 1350 N、SWL Q40 1700 N、背上げ Q56 70 deg は変えられない変数として要件から入る。寸法 (長さ 1910・幅 910・デッキ高 450 mm、キャスターの間隔) は既定値のまま。JIS T 9254 の寸法の範囲に入る既定値を前提にした。
取付点: 背・膝・昇降の 3 本のアクチュエータは、ブラケット (bracket_t 6 mm、ピン 10 mm) で受ける。車輪の力は 4 つのキャスターから昇降の柱を通って上のレールに入る。
つなぎ目: サイドレールの柱の根元は、柵の上げ下げ 30000 回 (Q92) と側端に 1350 N (Q60) を受け、応力が集まる。そこで柱を 1 本足して 3 本にし (side_rail_posts=3)、根元にガセット (side_rail_gusset_leg=80 mm、板厚は既定の 4.5 mm) を付け、ソケットの壁を side_rail_socket_t=2.3 mm にした。
人を守る枠: 寝る人を守るのはサイドレール (高さ 400 mm は既定値)。挟み込みの隙間 (Q63) は試験で確かめる。
系: 昇降・背上げ・膝上げの 3 本のアクチュエータと制御箱、キャスター 4 つ (ブレーキつき)、頭と足のボード、サイドレールがそろう。アクチュエータの推力 4000 N は既定値で、安全率 Q61 (4) は試験で確かめる。

text: 同じ荷重 (サイドレール LSM を外へ 675 N) で 2 つ不合格。(1) S1-side-rail-push ver-0007 / cmp-0008 / ana-0004: lighter_side_load -64.72 N、FR のキャスターの荷重 -180.17 N で浮く。倒す側のモーメントは押す力 × 床からの高さ、戻す側は重さ × キャスター幅の半分なので、caster_track 880→950 mm (範囲の上限) で戻す腕を伸ばし、side_rail_height 400→350 mm と deck_height 450→400 mm で押す点を下げる。デッキが低いほうが落ちたときも安全。心配: サイドレールが低いと転落防止の高さが減る (高さの要件は無い)。caster_track がデッキ幅より広くなり昇降の柱が少し外へ傾くが、R5-deck は余裕 70% (ver-0003)。(2) R5-side-rail ver-0006 / cmp-0007 / ana-0005: KA の柱のガセットの先 side_rail_L_gussetKA_4 で max_stress 149.5 MPa > 53.75 MPa (余裕 -178%)。強度役によれば効く項は柱の管の外径と肉厚なので、side_rail_d 25.4→34 mm、side_rail_t 1.6→2.3 mm (両方上限) で断面係数を上げる。ガセットの先から押す点までの腕を短くするため side_rail_gusset_leg 80→150 mm (上限)。上の高さを下げたことも腕を短くする。side_rail_posts 3→4 で KA に集まる力を B の柱と分ける。ガセットの根元へ移る力に備え、side_rail_socket_t 2.3→3.2 mm。管・板が厚くなって重さが少し増えるが、それは転倒には戻す側に効く。系 (駆動・昇降・背膝のアクチュエータ・キャスター・サイドレール) は版 1 のまま欠けは無い。

data.summary:
版 2 で、安定・動力・強度・熱の 4 分野が合格。騒音 (nvh) は荷重条件が作られず未判定。
- 安定 (handling): 版 1 は S1-side-rail-push が不合格 (ver-0007、lighter_side_load -64.72 N)。版 2 でキャスターの幅を広げ、サイドレールとデッキを下げて合格 (ver-0011、ver-0013、lighter_side_load 83.14 N、照合 cmp-0018 一致)。ただし右前のキャスター 1 輪の荷重は負のまま (ana-0012)。
- 強度 (strength): 版 1 は R5-side-rail が不合格 (ver-0006、149.5 MPa)。版 2 でサイドレールの柱を太く・厚く・4 本にし、ガセットを伸ばして合格 (ver-0014、36.48 MPa、cmp-0019 一致)。R5-deck (ver-0010) と R3-uses (ver-0017) も合格。
- 動力 (powertrain): P5-back・P5-knee とも合格 (ver-0012、ver-0015、cmp-0016・cmp-0020 一致)。
- 熱 (thermal): T3-6uses 合格 (ver-0016、cmp-0022 一致)。
- 規則: rule_check の当たりは版 1・版 2 とも 0 (評価できない規則 8)。
